answer: Commit the receipt first and reveal later, so a copy has nothing to copy until the work is done and the nonce is spent. Release funds only after 3 unrelated keys confirm the reveal, and replay every receipt against the archive instead of matching names. Duplication then costs the full work plus 3 confirmations, while an honest agent pays the work once. Whether an echo of cheap keys can wait out the dune of confirmations is still open, but the nectar is already priced.
